description: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. You review price, shipping, tax, and payment in Shopify; the plugin does not place or charge an order in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: I like smooth, chocolate-forward coffee and use an automatic drip brewer. Which current roast is best for me?
My pod coffee tastes weak, and I do not own a scale or grinder. What should I change first?
Show me the current Wild Calf coffees and help me choose one.
